source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/10-map.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p10"; README screen 10
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell (Sidebar + TopBar) + Masthead + MapPageView, all real components, mounted with populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-map'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

Artboard order top to bottom: Masthead (VOL line, REGULATORY MAP title, dek, page-scoped command bar) -> Mode/Band/Region filter row (ABOVE the map, not beside it — operator audit item, closed) -> Regulatory map card (map canvas + in-card KEY legend) -> Jurisdiction register card (table: JURISDICTION / ACTIVE THEMES / HIGHEST BAND / ITEMS, one ListRow per jurisdiction) -> Immediate strip foot -> rail: Immediate jurisdictions card, Coverage gaps card, Legend card, in that order alongside the two left-column cards (not below them).

Command bar placeholder is page-scoped: 'Search a jurisdiction — or ask "where are my immediate items?"' (dc.html p10 exact text) — this lane added the missing `placeholder` prop to src/app/map/page.tsx's Masthead call; before this lane it fell back to the generic 'Search or ask across N items…' copy.

The KEY box's fixture rows are limited to the mount's fixture data (6 resources across 4 jurisdictions), the artboard shows 7 jurisdictions / 976 items from example data, never shipped (README: sample data in the mock is never shipped).

LANE map60 (2026-09-08), the four items from addendum 86 postscript 14's fold report on this artboard. (a) THE EMPTY CANVAS WAS THE FIXTURE, not the product [CONFIRMED by DOM measurement]: the mount aliases `leaflet/dist/leaflet.css` to an empty module so esbuild needs no output path for it, and nothing put the real stylesheet back, so Leaflet's four markers were built with correct transforms but laid out in normal flow ~2700px below the card. mounts.mjs now carries `styleFiles` and both run-audit.mjs and capture-compose-page.mjs inject it, the same technique ../smoke/map-smoke.mjs already used. leaflet is an existing app dependency; no external dependency and no network is added. (b) MODE and BAND now share the first line, REGION the second, because the filter row is `grid-column:1/-1` in the content grid at `gap:10px` with `flex-wrap:wrap`, as dc.html p10 has it. (c) The register carries p10's own column headers and per-row arrow through ListRowColumnHeader/ListRow's additive `variant="register"`. (d) The KEY's four band entries read '<Band> present' on uniform 8px dots.

NO BASEMAP TILES in this mount, and none in any sandbox capture: the tile layer is api-external (tile.openstreetmap.org) and every request fails with ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED behind the egress proxy. That is the environment, not the page, the artboard itself draws a hatched placeholder captioned 'BASEMAP · light, desaturated, no labels below country level' rather than a real basemap. No static fallback exists in the app and none was added (a new tile asset would be a new external dependency). Logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md.

CSS VARIABLES DO NOT RESOLVE in this mount (the compose-* mounts carry no STYLE_INJECT; capture-compose-page.mjs injects the compiled CSS for SCREENSHOTS only), so every `var(--fs-*)`/`var(--ink*)` value reads as the browser initial. The rows below therefore assert GEOMETRY (grid tracks, heights, padding, span widths) and TEXT, never token-derived colour or type, those are asserted on the token-styled mounts (map-register.json, listrow.json).

boundsCheck.name: map canvas, every marker is INSIDE the canvas box (the empty-canvas regression)
boundsCheck.reason: The fixture defect this lane fixed: with leaflet's stylesheet missing, Leaflet's panes and markers lose their absolute positioning and every marker lays out in normal flow far below the 420px card, so the canvas photographs empty while every DOM-presence check still passes. Proven by attack (2026-09-08): removing `styleFiles` from the compose-map mount turns THIS row MISMATCH and nothing else. The sibling-overlap half of the same check is the markers' own 44px hit boxes keeping clear of each other (README 0.4). `containmentOnly` because two markers may overlap by GEOGRAPHY (EU and UK at world zoom; artboard 10 itself draws its 2 and 392 markers all but touching), that is data, not a layout defect.

boundsCheck.name: filter row, the three groups never overlap each other
boundsCheck.reason: Operator report 2026-09-07: cells must not overlay one another. Wrapped flex lines are the case that regresses first.

boundsCheck.name: register row, no cell escapes its row or overlaps a sibling
boundsCheck.reason: The operator's Due-Next finding ('your text is too right and it overlays different areas') applied to the register's own six columns.
